title: Pin games on the lobby

pr.title: Pin games on the lobby
pr.body:
## Summary
- Players can pin up to six games from the lobby. A Pinned row appears when the `pin-games` control point is on.
- Pin and unpin stay available on the API. Failures cover an unknown game, a game that is already pinned, a game that is not pinned, and the six-pin cap.
- The lobby records `arcade_web_pins_total` on success and `arcade_web_pin_errors_total` on failure.
- The match-replay flag is read once in the games use case.

## Test plan
- [ ] With `pin-games` on, pin a game and confirm it shows in the Pinned row.
- [ ] Unpin it and confirm the row clears.
- [ ] Pin the same game twice and confirm the already-pinned error.
- [ ] Pin a seventh game and confirm the limit error.
- [ ] With the flag off, confirm the lobby has no pin controls.
